lead.headline: Tuten hurt on the first snap; Chem is all but lost
lead.deck: 4% with Jefferson to play. Nothing can be moved; the question is Tuten's Week 12.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten aggravated his foot/ankle on Jacksonville's first play and limped off; he was later on the sideline bike with no update (NBC; Heavy). Likely was active but has nothing yet. Panda Attack lead 110.7 to 42.5 after Dallas scored 51. Jefferson plays tonight with Cousins at quarterback; Diggs on Monday cannot replace a locked starter. Metcalf, on your bench, was ejected at Philadelphia; no suspension has been reported. The Steelers D/ST claim closed WRONG by one point against the Chiefs.
